examples.english: In order to get free health care, you need to register with a doctor.
examples.persian: برای دریافت خدمات درمانی رایگان، باید نزد یک پزشک ثبت‌نام کنید.

miniContext: In order to get free health care, you need to register with a doctor.

examples.english: When I moved to Brighton, I had to register with a doctor near my home.
examples.persian: وقتی به برایتون نقل مکان کردم، باید نزد پزشکی نزدیک خانه‌ام ثبت‌نام می‌کردم.

miniContext: When I moved to Brighton, I had to register with a doctor near my home.

examples.english: I asked the doctor to refer me to a specialist because of my long-term skin problem.

examples.english: How do I get referred to a specialist?

miniContext: How do I get referred to a specialist?

examples.english: For many common illnesses, the doctor will give you a prescription.

examples.english: What if I suspect a doctor has made a mistake?

examples.english: How many participants are taking part in the clinical trial for the new cancer drug?

examples.english: Some cosmetic surgery is available on the National Health Service.

examples.english: Prescriptions are free of charge if you are under 16 or over 60.

examples.english: All medical treatment has to be strictly confidential between the doctor and patient.
examples.persian: همه‌ی درمان‌های پزشکی باید کاملاً بین پزشک و بیمار محرمانه بماند.

miniContext: All medical treatment has to be strictly confidential between the doctor and patient.

examples.english: The doctors and nurses were very dedicated and kept me informed at all times.
